name: Pedro Bernardo (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pedro Bernardo (parted with a cross on green and figures, inscribed).
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 15 January 2003 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 27 of 10 February 2003); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of three stripes, red above, white at the centre bearing the arms and green below, in the proportions 1/4, 2/4 and 1/4.
